[RAOT.6.2a] For XIP targets (`xtensa-esp32s3`), the `CompiledCode` atom body
is mapped directly from read-only flash and cannot be patched at
load time.  These targets use **zero-length slot tables**: the
generated RHS code accesses external functions exclusively through
the `dispatch` argument (a `const ds_dispatch_t *` passed at every
call).  `AOT_SLOT_TABLE_SIZE` is 0 for `xtensa-esp32s3`.
W^X is trivially satisfied — the flash mapping is permanently
read+execute with no writable phase.

The runtime populates each entry at load time for non-XIP targets
(RAOT.3.4, step 3).
